Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error was when WebSurfer clicked the Whole Foods Market result but landed on the UK site instead of the Chicago store page. More importantly, the later conclusion was wrong because the final answer listed Whole Foods Market, Trader Joe’s, and Mariano’s as if all were confirmed to have ready-to-eat salads under $15 within 2 blocks of Lincoln Park. In the conversation, only Mariano’s was actually verified with salad prices; Trader Joe’s and Whole Foods were not properly price-checked, so the final solution was based on incomplete and partially incorrect evidence.
